title: Walk through Frank Lloyd Wright’s Taliesin West
description: At Taliesin West in Scottsdale, follow a tour through the desert home and studio Frank Lloyd Wright built with his apprentices. Low roofs, angled walls, and views toward the mountains show how the place responds to its surroundings. Look beyond the famous name to the rooms where a community lived, worked, and kept changing the site.
teaser: See architecture shaped by the Sonoran Desert.
goodToKnow: Before you go, confirm a manageable guided route, walking and accessibility.
whyItMightDelightYou: Walking the rooms makes Wright’s design ideas easier to feel than any photograph can.
